payload.notes:
Application: Senior Academics Manager – Srikesh Iyer (M.Tech Robotics, 5+ Yrs K-12 EdTech)
​Hi!
​I am applying for the Senior Academics Manager position. With an M.Tech in Robotics from IIT Gandhinagar and 5+ years driving K–12 EdTech operations, my background perfectly bridges deep STEM expertise with scalable curriculum execution.
​I am a strong fit for this role because I bring:
​Robotics & STEM Pedagogy: My foundation in experiential, inquiry-based STEM was built at IITGN—working hands-on with the Creative Learning Initiative (CLI) and Nyasa—and through my IEEE/Neurorobotics publications.
​Pedagogical Rigor: I hold a B.Ed. and am CTET-qualified, ensuring my curriculum frameworks strictly adhere to cognitive load balance and national academic standards.
​Curriculum & Delivery at Scale: I have overseen the end-to-end design of 4,500+ K–12 content decks and 100+ chapters.
​Teacher Training & Implementation: I have designed training for and managed 80+ mentors/Master Teachers, and successfully implemented programs across 15+ partner schools (MOUs).
​I would love to bring my technical background and systems-driven approach to your academic team.
​Best regards,
​Srikesh Iyer
